question: In his prayer, whose sins did Nehemiah confess?
options: The sins of the Israelites, including himself and his father's family
Only the sins of the people living in Jerusalem
Only the sins of the kings of Judah
The sins of the Babylonians who destroyed the city
explanation: Nehemiah confessed the sins of the Israelites and said that he and his father's family had also sinned and had not obeyed God's commands.
